name: KokobeoChat – Live Chat, AI Support & Multi-Channel Widget
author: KokobeoChat

sections.description:
KokobeoChat is the easiest way to add live chat, AI support and multi-channel messaging to your WordPress site.

Connect with your visitors in real time, automate responses with a self-learning AI, and let customers reach you on their favorite channel: Live Chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, or Email — all from one single widget.

Why KokobeoChat?

  • Free plan — no credit card required
  • Real-time live chat with operators
  • Self-learning AI trained on your content
  • Multi-channel widget: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Email (Pro & Business plans)
  • 14 languages supported with real-time translation
  • Mobile-friendly widget
  • Multiple operators with auto-assign
  • Chat history and star reviews
  • 15-day free trial on paid plans
  • Easy 1-minute setup
  • Works with all themes and page builders

Multi-Channel Widget (Pro & Business plans)

Give your visitors the freedom to choose how they contact you. The KokobeoChat widget now supports 5 channels in one bubble:

  • Live Chat — always on, real-time operator reply
  • WhatsApp — one tap opens WhatsApp with your pre-filled welcome message
  • Facebook Messenger — direct link to your Facebook page inbox
  • Instagram — direct message to your Instagram business account
  • Email — fallback with pre-filled subject

All channels are configured from your KokobeoChat admin dashboard in seconds. Toggle what you want, add your phone number or username, save — and your widget updates live.

This feature is available on the Pro (€29/month) and Business (€79/month) plans. Live Chat alone remains fully free forever.

Perfect for

  • E-commerce stores (WooCommerce, Shopify)
  • Service businesses and professionals
  • Agencies and freelancers
  • SaaS companies
  • Any WordPress site that needs customer support

How to get started

  1. Sign up free at chat.kokobeo.com
  2. Install and activate this plugin
  3. Paste your API key in Settings → KokobeoChat
  4. Done — your chat widget is live!
  5. (Pro / Business) Enable WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram or Email from your dashboard
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for KokobeoChat
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to Settings → KokobeoChat
  5. Click REGISTER FREE to create your account (or LOGIN if you already have one)
  6. Enter your API key from chat.kokobeo.com
  7. (Optional, Pro/Business) Open the admin dashboard → Channels and enable WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram or Email
sections.faq:
Is KokobeoChat free?

Yes! The Free plan includes Live Chat with unlimited conversations and no credit card required. The Pro plan (€29/month) and Business plan (€79/month) unlock the multi-channel widget, advanced AI features, and more. Both paid plans include a 15-day free trial.

Which plan do I need for WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and Email channels?

The multi-channel widget (visitor-facing channel selector for WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and Email) is included on Pro and Business plans. The Free plan includes Live Chat only.

Where do I get my API key?

Sign up at chat.kokobeo.com — your API key is generated instantly after registration. You’ll find it in your admin dashboard under API Keys.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, KokobeoChat works perfectly with WooCommerce, Elementor, Divi, Astra, GeneratePress and all major themes and page builders.

How does the multi-channel widget work?

Visitors click the chat bubble and see a clean menu with Live Chat, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and Email. They pick their favorite channel and land in the conversation instantly — with your pre-filled welcome message on WhatsApp and Email. Only channels you enable are shown.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. See our privacy policy at chat.kokobeo.com/privacy.

How many languages does it support?

14 languages with automatic visitor-language detection and real-time translation: English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Czech, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Turkish.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously after your page is fully rendered, so it never blocks your content.
